waypoints.name: Andrews Creek Trailhead
waypoints.note: Long approach via Andrews Creek/Andrews Pass/Boundary Trail to Upper Cathedral Lake, then ~40 min to the base of The Monk.
waypoints.directions: The drive is straightforward: from Winthrop, follow the Chewuch River valley north on West Chewuch Road / FR-51, paved the entire way, about 23 miles to the Andrews Creek Trailhead at roughly 3,040 ft. Andrews Creek Trail #504 leaves from the parking area, and a free self-issue wilderness permit is filled out here — you also need a trailhead parking pass displayed on the car. Day one of the standard plan is a 17 to 20 mile hike to Upper Cathedral Lake, so drive in early and expect to be walking for most of the day. This is a two to four day backpack, so pack the car for a trip, not an outing.

waypoints.name: The Monk (tower top)
waypoints.note: The Monk is a small semi-detached tower leaning against Cathedral Peak's flank, in the gully between the two formations.
